'''Pon'Dart''' was an individual who,<ref name="Tethan" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]'' is set during the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> visited a [[Unidentified Raidos cantina|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Raidos]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]<ref name="Tethan" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> while carrying a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]],<ref name="Tethan" /> a signature [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It's Pon'Dart. He has business with the cantina owner.|Quar Rohk in one adventure path in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''|<ref name="Tethan" />}}
[[File:Dyd2_bg.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Pon'Dart was introduced in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''.]]
Pon'Dart appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], [[Sue Behrent]]'s [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books. In one adventure path the reader may take in the book's story, the [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|protagonist]]&mdash;a [[Tethan]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]]&mdash;and their friend [[Peder]] visit a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in Raidos, where they meet the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Quar Rohk]] and the [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] thief [[Lippoo]]. While the two Tethans are engaged in a conversation with the thieves, across the room an argument escalates to shouting and the ignition of a lightsaber.<ref name="Tethan" />

The table at which the younglings and thieves are sitting is then kicked over, with Rohk pulling the pair behind the piece of furniture. The thief then informs the Tethans in a grunting manner that the argument involves Pon'Dart having "business" with the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Unidentified cantina owner|owner]] of the cantina. At that point, a scream is emitted and a [[Color/Legends|red]]-colored [[Limb/Legends|hand]] gripping a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] flies to the younglings' end of the establishment, after which Rohk picks up the weapon and sends the Tethans out of the cantina.<ref name="Tethan" />
